From 40d5c8e94751f4a4fa4e0e27e3805e201a4e79c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sergei Shtylyov <sergei.shtylyov@cogentembedded.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Feb 2018 23:09:48 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] soc: renesas: r8a77970-sysc: fix power area parents
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

According to the figure 9.2(b) of the R-Car Series, 3rd Generation User’s
Manual: Hardware Rev. 0.80 the A2IRn and A2SCn power areas in R8A77970 have
the A3IR area as a parent, thus the SYSC driver has those parents wrong...

Fixes: bab9b2a74fe9 ("soc: renesas: rcar-sysc: add R8A77970 support")
Signed-off-by: Sergei Shtylyov <sergei.shtylyov@cogentembedded.com>
Reviewed-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Signed-off-by: Simon Horman <horms+renesas@verge.net.au>

diff --git a/drivers/soc/renesas/r8a77970-sysc.c b/drivers/soc/renesas/r8a77970-sysc.c
index 8c614164718e..caf894f193ed 100644
--- a/drivers/soc/renesas/r8a77970-sysc.c
+++ b/drivers/soc/renesas/r8a77970-sysc.c
@@ -25,12 +25,12 @@ static const struct rcar_sysc_area r8a77970_areas[] __initconst = {
 	  PD_CPU_NOCR },
 	{ "cr7",	0x240, 0, R8A77970_PD_CR7,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
 	{ "a3ir",	0x180, 0, R8A77970_PD_A3IR,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
-	{ "a2ir0",	0x400, 0, R8A77970_PD_A2IR0,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
-	{ "a2ir1",	0x400, 1, R8A77970_PD_A2IR1,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2ir2",	0x400, 2, R8A77970_PD_A2IR2,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2ir3",	0x400, 3, R8A77970_PD_A2IR3,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2sc0",	0x400, 4, R8A77970_PD_A2SC0,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
-	{ "a2sc1",	0x400, 5, R8A77970_PD_A2SC1,	R8A77970_PD_A2SC0 },
+	{ "a2ir0",	0x400, 0, R8A77970_PD_A2IR0,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir1",	0x400, 1, R8A77970_PD_A2IR1,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir2",	0x400, 2, R8A77970_PD_A2IR2,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir3",	0x400, 3, R8A77970_PD_A2IR3,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2sc0",	0x400, 4, R8A77970_PD_A2SC0,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2sc1",	0x400, 5, R8A77970_PD_A2SC1,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
 };
 
 const struct rcar_sysc_info r8a77970_sysc_info __initconst = {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/soc/renesas/r8a77970-sysc.c`**
- The parent areas for `a2ir0`, `a2ir1`, `a2ir2`, `a2ir3`, `a2sc0`, and `a2sc1` have been modified:
  - Changed from having `R8A77970_PD_A2IR0` and `R8A77970_PD_A2SC0` as their parent to `R8A77970_PD_A3IR`.
  
**Original Lines:**
```c
-	{ "a2ir0",	0x400, 0, R8A77970_PD_A2IR0,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
-	{ "a2ir1",	0x400, 1, R8A77970_PD_A2IR1,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2ir2",	0x400, 2, R8A77970_PD_A2IR2,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2ir3",	0x400, 3, R8A77970_PD_A2IR3,	R8A77970_PD_A2IR0 },
-	{ "a2sc0",	0x400, 4, R8A77970_PD_A2SC0,	R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON },
-	{ "a2sc1",	0x400, 5, R8A77970_PD_A2SC1,	R8A77970_PD_A2SC0 },
```

**Modified Lines:**
```c
+	{ "a2ir0",	0x400, 0, R8A77970_PD_A2IR0,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir1",	0x400, 1, R8A77970_PD_A2IR1,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir2",	0x400, 2, R8A77970_PD_A2IR2,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2ir3",	0x400, 3, R8A77970_PD_A2IR3,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2sc0",	0x400, 4, R8A77970_PD_A2SC0,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
+	{ "a2sc1",	0x400, 5, R8A77970_PD_A2SC1,	R8A77970_PD_A3IR },
```

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications made in the `r8a77970-sysc.c` file are intended to correct the power area parent relationships for specific power domains (`a2ir` and `a2sc`) in the R8A77970 system-on-chip (SoC). Previously, these domains were incorrectly assigned to their own parent areas or to the `R8A77970_PD_ALWAYS_ON` status. The patch ensures that all of them are now correctly set to have `A3IR` as their parent, aligning them accurately with the specifications in the R-Car Series 3rd Generation User’s Manual. This change addresses a previously identified bug noted in the commit history.
